hero.heading: Your new wellness bestie.
hero.intro: I know what it feels like to be stuck. I've been exactly where you are.
paragraphs: Battling depression, anxiety, a sugar addiction I couldn't shake, and a body I didn't recognize. I tried everything and nothing worked. Until I stopped dieting and started building a life I actually loved living in.
I lost 52 pounds, 4 dress sizes, and gained confidence I never knew I had. And I've kept it off for over 15 years. Not through restriction, but through the exact method I now teach.

transformation.heading: I never ask women to go somewhere I've never been.
transformation.description: I know what it's like to feel uncomfortable in your body. These photos remind me why this work matters.
transformation.resultText: I gained confidence, peace, freedom around food, and a life I genuinely love living.

method.heading: I built this because I needed it to exist.
method.description: I'm not a coach who just read a book. I'm a coach who lived it as a mom, a wife, a business owner, with a full life and real responsibilities. Now it's here for you.

finalSection.heading: Natural weight loss without restriction, shame, or starting over every Monday.
paragraphs: I'm here to disrupt the health industry with no drugs, no fad diets, no quick-fix lies.
I help ambitious women lose weight naturally and reclaim their energy, without calorie counting, restriction, or starting over every Monday. Dessert included!
My passion is empowering women to love themselves deeply through mindset coaching and nourishing food.
